select mo.id as order_id, -- 订单主键 (别名用于 ResultMap 的 id 和 collection 分组) mo.customer_id, mo.order_number, mo.service_id, mo.truck_type_id, mo.driver_id, mo.vehicle_id, mo.order_status, mo.reservation_time, mo.moving_origin, mo.moving_destination, mo.moving_price, mo.mileage_cost, mo.helper_cost, mo.category_price_multiplier, -- 费用明细字段 mo.is_paid, mo.payment_time, mo.pay_method, mo.cancel_reason, mo.cancel_time, mo.moving_start_time, mo.moving_end_time, mo.number_of_helpers, mo.notes, mo.is_reviewed, mo.create_time, mo.update_time,
c.name as customer_name, c.phone as customer_phone, s.service_name, sc.type_name as category_name, tt.type_name as truck_type_name,
d.name as driver_name, d.phone as driver_phone,
v.license_plate_number as vehicle_plate,
m.id as mover_id, m.name as mover_name, m.phone as mover_phone
from moving_order mo join customer c on mo.customer_id = c.id join service s on mo.service_id = s.id join truck_type tt on mo.truck_type_id = tt.id join service_category sc on s.category_id = sc.id left join driver d on mo.driver_id = d.id left join vehicle v on mo.vehicle_id = v.id left join order_mover om on mo.id = om.order_id left join mover m on om.mover_id = m.id where mo.id = #{id}

SELECT mo.id, mo.order_number,
mo.order_status, mo.is_paid,
mo.reservation_time, mo.create_time,
mo.moving_origin, mo.moving_destination,
c.id AS customer_id, c.name AS customer_name, c.phone AS customer_phone,
s.id AS service_id, s.service_name, sc.id AS service_category_id, sc.type_name AS service_category_name, s.short_description AS service_short_description, s.loading_capacity_description AS service_loading_capacity_description,
tt.id AS truck_type_id, tt.type_name AS truck_type_name, tt.capacity AS truck_type_capacity, tt.description AS truck_type_description, tt.base_fare AS truck_type_base_fare,
mo.number_of_helpers,
mo.moving_price, mo.mileage_cost, mo.helper_cost, mo.category_price_multiplier,
mo.notes
FROM moving_order mo JOIN customer c ON mo.customer_id = c.id JOIN service s ON mo.service_id = s.id JOIN service_category sc ON s.category_id = sc.id JOIN truck_type tt ON mo.truck_type_id = tt.id
WHERE mo.id = #{orderId} AND mo.order_status = 0 AND mo.is_paid = 1 AND mo.truck_type_id IN ( SELECT truck_type_id FROM driver_truck_type WHERE driver_id = #{currentDriverId} )

SELECT mo.id, mo.order_number,
mo.order_status,
mo.reservation_time,
mo.moving_origin, mo.moving_destination,
s.service_name, sc.type_name AS service_category_name, tt.type_name AS truck_type_name,
mo.number_of_helpers,
mo.moving_price,
mo.create_time
FROM moving_order mo JOIN service s ON mo.service_id = s.id JOIN service_category sc ON s.category_id = sc.id JOIN truck_type tt ON mo.truck_type_id = tt.id
WHERE mo.driver_id = #{currentDriverId} AND mo.order_status IN (1, 2, 3) AND mo.is_paid = 1
AND mo.order_status = #{dto.orderStatus}
AND mo.reservation_time BETWEEN #{dto.startDate} AND #{dto.endDate}
AND mo.reservation_time >= #{dto.startDate}
AND mo.reservation_time <= #{dto.endDate}
AND mo.order_number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{dto.orderNumber}, '%')
ORDER BY mo.reservation_time ASC

SELECT mo.id, mo.order_number, mo.order_status, mo.is_paid, mo.reservation_time, mo.create_time, mo.payment_time, mo.moving_start_time, mo.moving_end_time, mo.moving_origin, mo.moving_destination, mo.number_of_helpers, mo.moving_price, mo.mileage_cost, mo.helper_cost, mo.category_price_multiplier, mo.notes, mo.truck_type_id AS requiredTruckTypeId,
c.id AS customer_id, c.name AS customer_name, c.phone AS customer_phone,
s.id AS service_id, s.service_name, s.short_description AS service_short_description, s.loading_capacity_description AS service_loading_capacity_description,
sc.id AS service_category_id, sc.type_name AS service_category_name,
tt.type_name AS truck_type_name, tt.capacity AS truck_type_capacity, tt.description AS truck_type_description, tt.base_fare AS truck_type_base_fare,
v.id AS assignedVehicle_id, v.license_plate_number AS assignedVehicle_license_plate_number, v.vehicle_brand AS assignedVehicle_vehicle_brand,
m.id AS assignedMover_id, m.name AS assignedMover_name, m.phone AS assignedMover_phone
FROM moving_order mo JOIN customer c ON mo.customer_id = c.id JOIN service s ON mo.service_id = s.id JOIN service_category sc ON s.category_id = sc.id JOIN truck_type tt ON mo.truck_type_id = tt.id LEFT JOIN vehicle v ON mo.vehicle_id = v.id LEFT JOIN order_mover om ON mo.id = om.order_id LEFT JOIN mover m ON om.mover_id = m.id WHERE mo.id = #{orderId} AND mo.driver_id = #{currentDriverId} AND mo.order_status IN (1, 2, 3) GROUP BY mo.id, mo.order_number, mo.order_status, mo.is_paid, mo.reservation_time, mo.create_time, mo.payment_time, mo.moving_start_time, mo.moving_end_time, mo.moving_origin, mo.moving_destination, mo.number_of_helpers, mo.moving_price, mo.mileage_cost, mo.helper_cost, mo.category_price_multiplier, mo.notes, mo.truck_type_id, c.id, c.name, c.phone, s.id, s.service_name, s.short_description, s.loading_capacity_description, sc.id, sc.type_name, tt.type_name, tt.capacity, tt.description, tt.base_fare, v.id, v.license_plate_number, v.vehicle_brand, m.id, m.name, m.phone ORDER BY mo.reservation_time ASC -- 示例排序

SELECT mo.id, mo.order_number,
mo.order_status,
mo.is_paid,
mo.is_reviewed,
mo.create_time, mo.reservation_time, mo.moving_start_time, mo.moving_end_time, mo.cancel_time,
mo.moving_origin, mo.moving_destination,
mo.moving_price,
mo.number_of_helpers,
s.service_name AS service_name, sc.type_name AS service_category_name, tt.type_name AS truck_type_name, tt.capacity AS truck_type_capacity, v.license_plate_number AS license_plate_number,
c.name AS customer_name FROM moving_order mo LEFT JOIN service s ON mo.service_id = s.id LEFT JOIN service_category sc ON s.category_id = sc.id LEFT JOIN truck_type tt ON mo.truck_type_id = tt.id LEFT JOIN vehicle v ON mo.vehicle_id = v.id LEFT JOIN customer c ON mo.customer_id = c.id
mo.driver_id = #{currentDriverId} AND mo.order_status IN (4, 5)
AND mo.order_number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{queryDTO.orderNumber}, '%')
AND c.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{queryDTO.customerName}, '%')
AND mo.moving_end_time >= #{queryDTO.beginEndTime}
AND mo.moving_end_time <= #{queryDTO.endEndTime}
AND mo.order_status = #{queryDTO.orderStatus}
ORDER BY mo.moving_end_time DESC

SELECT mo.id AS mo_id, mo.order_number AS mo_order_number, mo.order_status AS mo_order_status, mo.is_paid AS mo_is_paid, mo.payment_time AS mo_payment_time, mo.pay_method AS mo_pay_method, mo.is_reviewed AS mo_is_reviewed, mo.create_time AS mo_create_time, mo.reservation_time AS mo_reservation_time, mo.moving_start_time AS mo_moving_start_time, mo.moving_end_time AS mo_moving_end_time, mo.cancel_time AS mo_cancel_time, mo.moving_origin AS mo_moving_origin, mo.moving_destination AS mo_moving_destination, mo.moving_price AS mo_moving_price, mo.mileage_cost AS mo_mileage_cost, mo.helper_cost AS mo_helper_cost, mo.category_price_multiplier AS mo_category_price_multiplier, mo.number_of_helpers AS mo_number_of_helpers, mo.notes AS mo_notes, mo.cancel_reason AS mo_cancel_reason, mo.update_time AS mo_update_time,
c.id AS c_id, c.name AS c_name, c.phone AS c_phone, c.email AS c_email,
s.id AS s_id, s.service_name AS s_service_name, s.short_description AS s_short_description, s.loading_capacity_description AS s_loading_capacity_description,
sc.id AS sc_id, sc.type_name AS sc_type_name, sc.description AS sc_description,
tt.id AS tt_id, tt.type_name AS tt_type_name, tt.capacity AS tt_capacity, tt.description AS tt_description, tt.base_fare AS tt_base_fare,
v.id AS v_id, v.license_plate_number AS v_license_plate_number, v.vehicle_brand AS v_vehicle_brand
FROM moving_order mo LEFT JOIN customer c ON mo.customer_id = c.id LEFT JOIN service s ON mo.service_id = s.id LEFT JOIN service_category sc ON s.category_id = sc.id LEFT JOIN truck_type tt ON mo.truck_type_id = tt.id LEFT JOIN vehicle v ON mo.vehicle_id = v.id WHERE mo.id = #{orderId} AND mo.driver_id = #{currentDriverId}

SELECT mo.id AS order_id, mo.order_number,
mo.order_status, CASE mo.order_status WHEN 0 THEN '待接单' WHEN 1 THEN '司机已接单，等待搬运工人' WHEN 2 THEN '已接单（团队已确认）' WHEN 3 THEN '进行中' WHEN 4 THEN '已完成' WHEN 5 THEN '已取消' ELSE '未知状态' END AS order_status_label, mo.is_paid, CASE mo.is_paid WHEN 0 THEN '未支付' WHEN 1 THEN '已支付' WHEN 2 THEN '已退款' ELSE '未知支付状态' END AS is_paid_label,
mo.reservation_time, mo.create_time,
mo.moving_origin, mo.moving_destination,
mo.number_of_helpers,
mo.moving_price, mo.mileage_cost, mo.helper_cost, mo.category_price_multiplier,
mo.notes,
c.id AS customer_id, c.name AS customer_name, c.phone AS customer_phone,
s.id AS service_id, s.service_name, sc.id AS service_category_id, sc.type_name AS service_category_name, s.short_description AS service_short_description, s.loading_capacity_description AS service_loading_capacity_description,
tt.id AS required_truck_type_id, tt.type_name AS truck_type_name, tt.capacity AS truck_type_capacity, tt.description AS truck_type_description,
d.id AS driver_id, d.name AS driver_name, d.phone AS driver_phone,
v.id AS vehicle_id, v.license_plate_number, v.vehicle_brand,
om.mover_id, m.name AS mover_name, m.phone AS mover_phone FROM moving_order mo LEFT JOIN customer c ON mo.customer_id = c.id LEFT JOIN service s ON mo.service_id = s.id LEFT JOIN service_category sc ON s.category_id = sc.id LEFT JOIN truck_type tt ON mo.truck_type_id = tt.id LEFT JOIN driver d ON mo.driver_id = d.id LEFT JOIN vehicle v ON mo.vehicle_id = v.id LEFT JOIN order_mover om ON mo.id = om.order_id LEFT JOIN mover m ON om.mover_id = m.id WHERE mo.id = #{orderId} AND mo.order_status = 1 AND mo.is_paid = 1

SELECT mo.id AS order_id, mo.order_number,
mo.order_status, CASE mo.order_status WHEN 1 THEN '司机已接单，等待搬运工人' WHEN 2 THEN '已接单（团队已确认）' WHEN 3 THEN '进行中' ELSE '未知状态' END AS order_status_label,
mo.reservation_time,
mo.moving_origin, mo.moving_destination,
mo.number_of_helpers, mo.moving_price,
s.service_name, sc.type_name AS service_category_name, tt.type_name AS truck_type_name,
d.name AS driver_name, v.license_plate_number AS vehicle_plate_number
FROM moving_order mo INNER JOIN order_mover om ON mo.id = om.order_id LEFT JOIN service s ON mo.service_id = s.id LEFT JOIN service_category sc ON s.category_id = sc.id LEFT JOIN truck_type tt ON mo.truck_type_id = tt.id LEFT JOIN driver d ON mo.driver_id = d.id LEFT JOIN vehicle v ON mo.vehicle_id = v.id WHERE om.mover_id = #{moverId} AND mo.order_status IN (1, 2, 3)
AND mo.order_status = #{dto.orderStatus}
AND mo.reservation_time >= #{dto.startDate}
AND mo.reservation_time <= #{dto.endDate}
AND mo.order_number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{dto.orderNumber}, '%')
ORDER BY mo.reservation_time DESC, mo.create_time DESC

SELECT mo.id AS order_id, mo.order_number,
mo.order_status, CASE mo.order_status WHEN 1 THEN '司机已接单，等待搬运工人' WHEN 2 THEN '已接单（团队已确认）' WHEN 3 THEN '进行中' ELSE '未知状态' END AS order_status_label, mo.is_paid, CASE mo.is_paid WHEN 0 THEN '未支付' WHEN 1 THEN '已支付' WHEN 2 THEN '已退款' ELSE '未知支付状态' END AS is_paid_label,
mo.reservation_time, mo.create_time, mo.payment_time, mo.moving_start_time, mo.moving_end_time,
mo.moving_origin, mo.moving_destination,
mo.number_of_helpers,
mo.moving_price, mo.mileage_cost, mo.helper_cost, mo.category_price_multiplier, mo.notes,
c.id AS customer_id, c.name AS customer_name, c.phone AS customer_phone,
s.id AS service_id, s.service_name, sc.id AS service_category_id, sc.type_name AS service_category_name, s.short_description AS service_short_description, s.loading_capacity_description AS service_loading_capacity_description,
tt.id AS required_truck_type_id, tt.type_name AS truck_type_name, tt.capacity AS truck_type_capacity, tt.description AS truck_type_description,
d.id AS driver_id, d.name AS driver_name, d.phone AS driver_phone,
v.id AS vehicle_id, v.license_plate_number, v.vehicle_brand,
om.mover_id, m.name AS mover_name, m.phone AS mover_phone FROM moving_order mo LEFT JOIN customer c ON mo.customer_id = c.id LEFT JOIN service s ON mo.service_id = s.id LEFT JOIN service_category sc ON s.category_id = sc.id LEFT JOIN truck_type tt ON mo.truck_type_id = tt.id LEFT JOIN driver d ON mo.driver_id = d.id LEFT JOIN vehicle v ON mo.vehicle_id = v.id LEFT JOIN order_mover om ON mo.id = om.order_id LEFT JOIN mover m ON om.mover_id = m.id WHERE mo.id = #{orderId}

SELECT mo.id AS order_id, mo.order_number,
mo.order_status, CASE mo.order_status WHEN 0 THEN '待接单' WHEN 1 THEN '司机已接单，等待搬运工人' WHEN 2 THEN '已接单（团队已确认）' WHEN 3 THEN '进行中' WHEN 4 THEN '已完成' WHEN 5 THEN '已取消' ELSE '未知状态' END AS order_status_label, mo.is_paid, CASE mo.is_paid WHEN 0 THEN '未支付' WHEN 1 THEN '已支付' WHEN 2 THEN '已退款' ELSE '未知支付状态' END AS is_paid_label, mo.is_reviewed,
mo.create_time, mo.reservation_time, mo.moving_start_time, mo.moving_end_time, mo.cancel_time,
mo.moving_origin, mo.moving_destination,
mo.moving_price,
s.service_name, sc.type_name AS service_category_name, tt.type_name AS truck_type_name, tt.capacity AS truck_type_capacity, v.license_plate_number, d.name AS driver_name,
c.name AS customer_name, mo.number_of_helpers FROM moving_order mo INNER JOIN order_mover om ON mo.id = om.order_id LEFT JOIN customer c ON mo.customer_id = c.id LEFT JOIN service s ON mo.service_id = s.id LEFT JOIN service_category sc ON s.category_id = sc.id LEFT JOIN truck_type tt ON mo.truck_type_id = tt.id LEFT JOIN vehicle v ON mo.vehicle_id = v.id LEFT JOIN driver d ON v.driver_id = d.id WHERE om.mover_id = #{moverId} AND mo.order_status IN (4, 5)
AND mo.order_number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{dto.orderNumber}, '%')
AND c.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{dto.customerName}, '%')
AND mo.moving_end_time >= #{dto.beginEndTime}
AND mo.moving_end_time <= #{dto.endEndTime}
AND mo.order_status = #{dto.orderStatus}
ORDER BY mo.moving_end_time DESC, mo.create_time DESC

SELECT mo.id AS order_id, mo.order_number,
mo.order_status, CASE mo.order_status WHEN 4 THEN '已完成' WHEN 5 THEN '已取消' ELSE '未知状态' END AS order_status_label, mo.is_paid, CASE mo.is_paid WHEN 0 THEN '未支付' WHEN 1 THEN '已支付' WHEN 2 THEN '已退款' ELSE '未知支付状态' END AS is_paid_label, mo.pay_method, CASE mo.pay_method WHEN 1 THEN '微信' WHEN 2 THEN '支付宝' WHEN 3 THEN '云闪付' ELSE '未知支付方式' END AS pay_method_label, mo.is_reviewed,
mo.create_time, mo.reservation_time, mo.payment_time, mo.moving_start_time, mo.moving_end_time, mo.cancel_time,
mo.moving_origin, mo.moving_destination,
c.id AS customer_id, c.name AS customer_name, c.phone AS customer_phone, c.email AS customer_email,
s.id AS service_id, s.service_name, sc.id AS service_category_id, sc.type_name AS service_category_name, s.short_description AS service_short_description, s.loading_capacity_description AS service_loading_capacity_description,
mo.truck_type_id AS required_truck_type_id, tt.type_name AS truck_type_name, tt.capacity AS truck_type_capacity, tt.description AS truck_type_description, tt.base_fare AS truck_type_base_fare,
mo.number_of_helpers,
v.id AS vehicle_id, v.license_plate_number, v.vehicle_brand AS vehicle_brand,
d.id AS driver_id, d.name AS driver_name, d.phone AS driver_phone,
mo.moving_price, mo.mileage_cost, mo.helper_cost, mo.category_price_multiplier,
mo.notes, mo.cancel_reason,
m_all.id AS mover_id_in_list, m_all.name AS mover_name_in_list, m_all.phone AS mover_phone_in_list,
r.id AS rating_id, r.rating_type, CASE r.rating_type WHEN 'SERVICE' THEN '服务评价' WHEN 'DRIVER' THEN '司机评价' WHEN 'MOVER' THEN '搬运工人评价' ELSE '未知类型' END AS rating_type_label, r.ratee_id, r.rating_value, r.comment, r.rating_time AS rating_time FROM moving_order mo INNER JOIN order_mover om ON mo.id = om.order_id AND om.mover_id = #{moverId} LEFT JOIN customer c ON mo.customer_id = c.id LEFT JOIN service s ON mo.service_id = s.id LEFT JOIN service_category sc ON s.category_id = sc.id LEFT JOIN truck_type tt ON mo.truck_type_id = tt.id LEFT JOIN vehicle v ON mo.vehicle_id = v.id LEFT JOIN driver d ON v.driver_id = d.id LEFT JOIN order_mover om_all ON mo.id = om_all.order_id LEFT JOIN mover m_all ON om_all.mover_id = m_all.id LEFT JOIN rating r ON mo.id = r.order_id WHERE mo.id = #{orderId} GROUP BY mo.id, m_all.id, r.id, mo.create_time ORDER BY mo.create_time DESC
